caption:
Desi Mushroom Kheema Spread 
breakfast | easy spread recipe | vegan spread | one pan | vegan pâté 

Nutrition: 
C: 20 | F: 6 | P: 11
Calories: 172 per serve (including bread ) 
( the entire batch of this mushroom spread without any toast or toppings is 180 calories for the entire bowl )
Makes 5 toasts with filling 

Ingredients 
for the desi mushroom kheema, 
2-3 sprays olive oil
1 tsp minced garlic
1 tsp grated ginger
1/2 onion, finely chopped
2 green chilli, finely chopped
250 grams mushroom 
1 tbsp tomato paste
spices: 1 tsp red chilli powder, 1 tsp coriander, 1 tsp garam masala, 1 tsp chaat masala, 1 tsp aamchur powder ( use as much or as little masala as you wish for the flavours) 
salt + black pepper to taste 
Coriander to garnish 

for assembly, 
5 slices of bread 
5 eggs
5 tbsp green chutney 

Method 
in a pan, add the oil along with minced garlic and ginger along with finely chopped onion and chilli 
add in the onions and chilli and cook till onions go translucent 
add in the finely chopped up mushrooms and tomato paste along with the masalas and cook it on high flame so it lets out all the water and the spices cook well 
garnish with coriander and it is ready to use 

to assemble, toast the bread, spread the chutney on followed by the mushroom kheema and finish with a runny fried egg or soft boiled egg 
going for the vegan option, just toast bread, add the spread + all the veges of your choice + tofu
